response.overview: Datin Nureen Azalea (Rita Rudaini) celebrates her 15th wedding anniversary with Datuk Nizar (Eizlan Yusof). Datuk Nizar hides his second wife from Datin Nureen's knowledge. Datuk Nizar's marriage to the scandalous woman named Fatin (Dayang Areeda) is exposed when their residence is broken into by a group of robbers. According to one of the robbers, named Iskandar (Jay Iswazir), the woman married by Datuk Nizar is his ex-wife. Moreover, Datin Nureen Azalea is shocked by this revelation, especially when she hears the story from her own husband's mouth. TV film actors No More
response.title: Tiada Lagi
